author: reek
body: This reads the EMITTED particles rather than recomposing the helpers, which is the only way to measure what the emitter does. Recomposing them by hand is how the first version of this probe kept reporting the old behaviour after the fix had landed.

author: reek
body: A marginal histogram cannot see this and did not: the spread of vx alone was even both before and after. The measurement has to be joint.
